admissibility_candidate_only.candidate_definition: an object eligible for later source-admissibility review if weak conservation and domain compatibility tests are satisfied

background_geometry_assumptions.connection: background-compatible derivative operator for weak tests
background_geometry_assumptions.geometry: fixed smooth or distributionally controlled background

candidate_next_targets.reason: Packet preparation must be result-reviewed before any model execution.
This artifact prepares the packet only; it does not execute the model.
The packet defines an admissibility candidate only and does not open this family.
Bianchi compatibility remains outside this packet-preparation target.
The packet does not construct a source-admissibility proof or close QFT-GR.

claim_ceiling: minimal working model demonstration packet only

conservation_test_target.target: weak tested divergence vanishing or explicit obstruction
conservation_test_target.test_form: evaluate the candidate against compactly supported test fields and record whether the weak conservation target is met

failure_modes: field/state setup cannot produce a finite expectation candidate
regularization or renormalization scope is incompatible with the test domain
derivative or limit-interchange assumptions remain insufficient in the model
the route requires a new exact missing condition family named by review
countermodel or scope rewrite is required

minimal_model_scope.purpose: prepare a bounded demonstration question that may either produce a source-like candidate or expose a precise obstruction
minimal_model_scope.scope: fixed controlled background with no backreaction

scientific_role: prepare the first bounded toy-model source test

simplified_field_state_setup.expectation_object: finite expectation candidate under imported domain conditions
simplified_field_state_setup.field_object: real scalar field placeholder on the controlled background
simplified_field_state_setup.state_object: bounded state or expectation functional placeholder

source_like_object_criteria: pairs with the selected distributional test domain
is finite under the selected regularization or renormalization scope
has indexed tensor-like slots suitable for later geometric source tests
does not by itself imply physical source admissibility

toy_source_candidate.candidate: regularized or renormalized expectation of a stress-energy-like tensor for the simplified field/state setup
